body.name: Admissible compact regular family \(\mathcal K\)
body.construction: \(\mathcal K\) is any subset of \(\mathcal Q_T\) satisfying \(\text{ass:family-compactness}\), \(\text{ass:uniform-envelope}\), \(\text{ass:uniform-envelope-moment}\), \(\text{ass:uniform-chart-interior}\), \(\text{ass:uniform-identification}\), \(\text{ass:uniform-mean-rank}\), \(\text{ass:uniform-variance-rank}\), \(\text{ass:uniform-overlap}\), \(\text{ass:uniform-gram-margin}\), and \(\text{ass:uniform-residual-margin}\), with the same named constants \(\delta_{\mathrm{mom}},B_{\mathcal E},\varepsilon_{\mathcal B},\varepsilon_{\mathrm{id}},c_{\mathrm{id}},\underline j,\underline x,\eta,\underline\kappa,\underline\rho\) for every \(Q\in\mathcal K\).
